spec_family.name: Exterior Stucco/EIFS Wall Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined condition assessment + prep + prime + finish repaint spec for previously coated exterior stucco and EIFS wall surfaces. Covers condition assessment (crack assessment FIRST — >1/8 inch HARD STOP, EIFS knock test for delamination, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, chalk rub test, moisture probe, caulk assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop'), surface prep (pressure wash branched by substrate type — 1500-3000 PSI traditional vs <500 PSI EIFS, mildew/efflorescence treatment, condition-driven scraping FAIR/POOR, degloss on GOOD condition, chalk remediation for SS_EXT_CHALKING, crack/surface patching, caulk removal and replacement), state-driven primer (chalk-binding for CHALKING, alkali-resistant spot on bare traditional stucco, acrylic stain-block for FAILING/PEELING — primer module skipped for SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion), finish coats (acrylic or elastomeric spray_backroll/roll/brush), interstage inspection/sanding at QT4, final walkthrough, and customer walkthrough (RP-specific occupied home). HARD CONSTRAINT: EIFS = acrylic ONLY — elastomeric PROHIBITED (catastrophic moisture entrapment). Spray_backroll is PRIMARY method — spray-only PROHIBITED. Texture profile (smooth/sand/lace/dash) is DOMINANT cost driver via DUAL multiplier on both labor (SF/hr) and material (SF/gal). SF-based with ITM_STUCCO_WALL. QT2-QT4. Flat/satin sheen. 4 SS_EXT_* substrate states. GOOD/FAIR/POOR condition scale. EPA lead-safe RRP gate for pre-1978 buildings.

includes: Condition assessment per elevation (visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, chalk rub test, moisture probe, substrate state classification, photo documentation)
Caulk joint assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol (all stucco-to-trim joints, expansion joints, penetration perimeters)
Crack assessment FIRST (>1/8 inch = HARD STOP for structural evaluation)
EIFS knock test for delamination detection (EIFS only — delamination = HARD STOP)
EIFS insurance verification (CGL policy covers EIFS work or EIFS-specific rider obtained)
Moisture content testing (MC <12% required before coating)
Pressure wash — traditional stucco (1500-3000 PSI)
Low-pressure wash — EIFS (<500 PSI — high pressure PROHIBITED)
Mildew eradication treatment (bleach solution 1:3, scrub, rinse)
Efflorescence treatment (traditional stucco only — water/TSP/acid hierarchy)
Light scraping and feather sanding (FAIR condition — localized failing areas)
Heavy scraping and feather sanding (POOR condition — widespread failing/peeling)
Degloss/scuff sanding (GOOD condition — adhesion prep on sound paint)
Chalk remediation pre-treatment (SS_EXT_CHALKING — chemical chalk remover after wash)
Cosmetic crack patching (<1/8 inch with elastomeric sealant)
Surface patching with texture match (spalled/damaged areas)
Caulk removal (failed joints) and replacement (polyurethane Class 25/50, 3-7 day cure)

State-driven primer: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING), alkali-resistant spot on bare traditional stucco (SS_EXT_FAILING/PEELING), acrylic stain-block (SS_EXT_FAILING/PEELING). Module skipped for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion.
Finish coat application — acrylic (1-2 coats by QT) or elastomeric (2 coats mandatory, traditional stucco only, QT3+ only, flat only)
Interstage inspection, QT4-only light sand on anomalies, dust removal
Final walkthrough inspection with before/after condition photo comparison
Touch-up with focus on feathered transition zones and crack patch blending
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based), hardscape protection (walk, patio)
Fixture masking (stucco tape), HVAC unit cover
Vehicle/driveway overspray protection (RP-specific — occupied home, spray_backroll)
Ground cover for scraping debris (RP-specific — FAIR/POOR condition)
Spray equipment setup and cleanup
Customer walkthrough upon completion (RP-specific)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP containment module for pre-1978 buildings (shared module)

excludes.item: Exterior trim repaint (corner boards, frieze, window/door casing)
excludes.route_to: SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 (caulk at stucco-to-trim junctions IS this spec's responsibility)
Window/door specs — protection owned by respective surface spec
Structural engineering — outside painting scope (HARD STOP)

excludes.item: EIFS system repair (delamination, EPS board replacement)
excludes.route_to: EIFS specialist contractor — outside painting scope (HARD STOP)
Contractor — moisture SOURCE must be resolved before painting (gate condition)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection rigor, interstage sanding, prep thoroughness, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single acrylic finish, no interstage, elastomeric NOT available). QT3=standard baseline (2 finish coats, interstage inspect, acrylic or elastomeric). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand on anomalies, systematic inspection, premium materials). QT5 excluded — stucco wall field is utilitarian surface.

configuration_dimensions.description: Stucco substrate type. Primary branching dimension for coating system constraint, wash pressure, LRV constraint, insurance requirements.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Traditional stucco: Portland cement/sand/lime. EIFS: EPS + polymer base + acrylic finish. HARD CONSTRAINT: EIFS = acrylic coating ONLY — elastomeric PROHIBITED. Per-elevation if mixed.

configuration_dimensions.description: Stucco texture profile. DOMINANT cost driver via DUAL multiplier on both labor rate (SF/hr) and material consumption (SF/gal).
configuration_dimensions.notes: Smooth=1.00x. Sand=1.25x. Lace=1.50x. Dash/roughcast=2.00x. Per-elevation if texture varies.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating system. Acrylic is standard; elastomeric for crack-bridging on traditional stucco only.
configuration_dimensions.notes: HARD CONSTRAINT: EIFS = acrylic ONLY. Elastomeric: traditional stucco, QT3+, flat only, 2 coats mandatory, 12-20 mils DFT, 5-8x material cost. Acrylic: all substrate types, all QT levels.
spray_backroll is PRIMARY (2-person crew). spray-only PROHIBITED per doctrine. roll is fallback for smaller areas. brush is detail work only.
Flat most common for stucco. Satin for EIFS. Elastomeric = flat only.

configuration_dimensions.description: Exterior substrate state classification from condition assessment. Drives primer selection and prep intensity.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 4 exterior RP states. SOUND_PAINT may skip prime. CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer. FAILING_PAINT/PEELING require stain-block + alkali spot on bare traditional. Worst-state-wins per v1. Per-elevation if conditions differ.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or localized SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x prep). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING or widespread SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (2.0x prep). Applies to prep tasks ONLY.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Stucco Wall Field Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable stucco/EIFS wall field area in SF per elevation, excluding window/door openings, trim elements. Measured from PaintScope PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.STUCCO_FIELD.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item. Reuse from SF_STUCCO_EXT_NC_v1. Covers both traditional 3-coat stucco and EIFS/synthetic stucco. Substrate_type drives primer/coating constraints. Texture_profile drives dual labor+material multiplier.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SOUND_PAINT = paint intact with verified adhesion. CHALKING = powdery surface degradation. FAILING_PAINT = cracking/checking/alligatoring but not delaminated. PEELING = delamination/flaking. Assessed per elevation during MOD_SCRP_ASSESS.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen. Flat is most common exterior stucco sheen.

SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT.notes: Skip prime module. Verified adhesion means direct-to-finish. Degloss/scuff in prep module provides adhesion profile.

SS_EXT_CHALKING.notes: Full-surface chalk-binding primer. MANDATORY — standard primer will NOT adhere to chalking surface.

SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT.notes: Full acrylic stain-block + alkali-resistant spot prime on any exposed bare traditional stucco.

SS_EXT_PEELING.notes: Full acrylic stain-block + alkali-resistant spot prime on bare areas. Extensive scraping creates more bare area than FAILING.

material_systems_summary.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Stucco Repaint
material_systems_summary.notes: RP_NEW. Full-surface chalk-binding primer. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING. Most common stucco RP primer scenario.

material_systems_summary.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Stucco Repaint
material_systems_summary.notes: RP_NEW. Adhesion bridge primer. Spot or full prime depending on failure extent.

material_systems_summary.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Exposed Bare Traditional Stucco (Reuse NC)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. SPOT application on bare areas only (RP context). Mandatory where scraping exposes bare stucco (pH 12-14).

material_systems_summary.name: Standard 100% Acrylic Exterior Finish (Reuse NC, QT2/QT3)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. Standard acrylic finish. QT2: 1 coat. QT3: 2 coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium 100% Acrylic Exterior Finish (Reuse NC, QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. Premium acrylic finish. 2 coats with intercoat sand.

material_systems_summary.name: Elastomeric Coating for Traditional Stucco (Reuse NC, QT3/QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Reuse NC. 2 coats mandatory. Flat only. PROHIBITED on EIFS. 5-8x material cost vs acrylic.

module_summary.description: Landscape/hardscape/fixture/HVAC protection, vehicle/driveway RP-specific, ground cover for scraping debris RP-specific, spray equipment setup
Condition assessment per elevation (ASTM D3359 adhesion, chalk rub, moisture probe, substrate state classification), caulk joint assessment

Crack assess FIRST, EIFS knock test, moisture test, wash (branched by substrate), mildew treatment, efflorescence treatment, scraping (light/heavy by condition), degloss, chalk remediation, crack/surface patch, caulk remove/apply, EIFS insurance
State-driven primer: chalk-binding spray_backroll/roll, alkali spot on bare, stain-block spray_backroll/roll, brush detail. Skipped for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT.
First finish coat: acrylic/elastomeric by spray_backroll/roll + brush detail
Intercoat inspection, QT4 light sand on anomalies, QT4 dust removal
Second finish coat (QT3/QT4). Same structure as coat 1.
Final walkthrough with before/after photo comparison, touch-up
Protection teardown, equipment cleanup, waste disposal (includes scraping debris), customer walkthrough (RP-specific)
Shared EPA lead-safe RRP module. Lead screening, containment setup, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, teardown. Pre-1978 only.

production_summary.notes: Prep pool can exceed 4.0x in extreme combinations — flagged for estimator review.

compatibility_rules.name: EIFS Elastomeric Prohibition
compatibility_rules.message: Elastomeric coating PROHIBITED on EIFS. Catastrophic moisture entrapment. Use acrylic only.

compatibility_rules.name: Elastomeric QT2 Prohibition
compatibility_rules.message: Elastomeric not available at QT2. Application complexity exceeds economy scope.

compatibility_rules.name: Elastomeric Sheen Constraint
compatibility_rules.message: Elastomeric coating available in flat sheen only.

compatibility_rules.name: Crack Width Hard Stop
compatibility_rules.message: Cracks exceeding 1/8 inch require structural evaluation before painting. Outside painting scope.

compatibility_rules.name: EIFS Delamination Hard Stop
compatibility_rules.message: EIFS delamination detected. Repair required by EIFS specialist before coating.

compatibility_rules.name: EIFS Insurance Gate
compatibility_rules.message: EIFS insurance verification required before proceeding. CGL must cover EIFS work.

compatibility_rules.name: EIFS LRV Constraint
compatibility_rules.message: Dark colors (LRV <20) on EIFS cause thermal cycling damage. Prefer LRV >50. Minimum LRV 20.

compatibility_rules.name: Spray-Only Prohibition
compatibility_rules.message: Spray-only PROHIBITED on stucco. Backroll mandatory per doctrine (forces coating into texture recesses).

compatibility_rules.name: Moisture Content Gate
compatibility_rules.message: Moisture content >12% — do not proceed with coating. Identify and resolve moisture source.

compatibility_rules.name: Sound Paint Prime Skip
compatibility_rules.message: Sound paint with verified adhesion — primer module skipped. Degloss/scuff provides adhesion profile.

round_configurations.name: Stucco RP — 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
round_configurations.notes: GOOD condition with verified adhesion. Skip prime. 2 finish coats. Most common QT3 scenario on well-maintained homes.

round_configurations.name: Stucco RP — 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy tier refresh. Single acrylic finish coat. GOOD condition only.

round_configurations.name: Stucco RP — State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Standard RP with primer. FAIR/POOR condition triggers state-driven primer + 2 finish coats.

round_configurations.name: Stucco RP — State-Driven Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2)
round_configurations.notes: Economy RP with primer. FAIR/POOR condition. Budget scenario.

round_configurations.name: Stucco RP — Prime + 2 Elastomeric Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Elastomeric system. Traditional stucco only. QT3+ only. Flat only. 2 coats mandatory for DFT target.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Well-maintained stucco, sound paint, verified adhesion. Degloss + 2 acrylic finish coats. No prime. Most common scenario.
Economy refresh. Single acrylic finish coat on sound paint.
Standard RP on chalking/failing stucco. State-driven prime + 2 acrylic finish coats. 1.5x prep modifier.
Full remediation on peeling stucco. Heavy scrape + state-driven prime + 2 acrylic finish coats. 2.0x prep modifier.
Premium refresh. 2 premium acrylic finish coats + intercoat sand on anomalies. No prime.
Premium remediation. State-driven prime + 2 premium acrylic finish + intercoat sand.
Economy RP on chalking/failing. State-driven prime + single acrylic finish coat.
Elastomeric system for crack-bridging on traditional stucco. State-driven prime + 2 elastomeric finish coats.
Premium elastomeric on traditional stucco. Full remediation + elastomeric with intercoat inspect.
Roll fallback on sound paint. Smaller areas or occupied-adjacent.
Roll fallback on chalking/failing. State-driven prime + 2 acrylic finish coats.
Lead-safe RP. RRP containment + 2.0x prep modifier + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Wet scraping methods.

adjacency_declarations.coordination_rule: Caulk at stucco-to-trim junctions is THIS spec's responsibility. Trim painting is SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1.

cross_spec_boundaries.caulk_responsibility: Stucco-to-trim caulk joints owned by this spec (SF_STUCCO_EXT_RP). Assessment, removal, and replacement included.
cross_spec_boundaries.window_door_protection: Window/door protection NOT this spec's responsibility — owned by window/door surface specs.
cross_spec_boundaries.shared_rrp_module: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs. Do NOT duplicate when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP or other exterior RP specs on same project.
cross_spec_boundaries.nc_sibling: SF_STUCCO_EXT_NC_v1 covers new/bare stucco. This spec covers previously coated stucco only.

site_condition_rules.effect: BLOCKS spray_backroll operations. Fall back to roll/brush.
BLOCKS all coating application. Reschedule to cooler time.
BLOCKS coating application. Stucco must be dry (MC <12%).

prep_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x texture)

coating_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x substrate_type x access x texture)

risk_flags: Dash texture + elastomeric + scaffold + QT4 approaches 4.0x coating stack cap (3.84x) — flag for estimator review
DUAL texture modifier on material coverage critical for accurate material estimates — dash uses 2x material vs smooth
Prep pool extreme combinations can exceed cap — flag POOR + RRP + scaffold + dash
EIFS knock test may reveal delamination — blocks project, scheduling risk
Moisture behind EIFS = catastrophic failure — moisture test is critical gate
Heavy scraping on POOR stucco may expose more bare area than estimated — primer quantity may increase
RRP wet scraping at 40 SF/hr on large POOR walls creates significant labor cost
Stucco tape adhesive residue on multi-day projects
sequencing_notes: 1. Condition assessment FIRST (assign substrate state per elevation)
2. Crack assessment — HARD STOP check before any prep
3. EIFS knock test (EIFS only) — HARD STOP check
5. EIFS insurance verification (EIFS only) — admin gate
7. Pressure wash (branched by substrate type, 24-48 hr dry time)
8. Condition-driven prep (scraping, degloss, chalk remediation, mildew, efflorescence)
9. Crack/surface patch, caulk remove/apply (3-7 day cure for caulk)
12. Interstage inspection (QT3/QT4), sand (QT4 only), dust removal (QT4)

dependencies.notes: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT shared — deduplicate when running alongside other exterior RP specs.
